steps.neighbors: A neighbor note steps a half step away and straight back: {e}, {dSharp}, {e}. Played lightly, it makes a little shiver around the main note. Fingers 5 and 4 rock between the two keys.
steps.slowly: Slowly, one note per beat: the opening of “Für Elise”.
steps.flowing: Now flowing, two notes per beat, with the metronome.
steps.furEliseRight: “Für Elise” by Beethoven, the opening, with the right hand: the shiver, then notes climbing up from below.
steps.furElise: Both hands: the left hand plays its three notes while the right hand waits, then the right hand answers.
steps.furEliseInTime: And in time with the metronome. Keep it soft.
